llm.summary: This skill is a focused credit-card wallet audit helper that uses web lookup for public card benefit research and does not install code, persist data, or modify accounts.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to audit a user-provided credit-card lineup; parsing card names, researching fees/benefits, and summarizing overlaps and gaps all fit that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger phrase "my cards" is broad, but the instructions narrow use to card-lineup evaluation and require asking when card identities are ambiguous.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single markdown skill file with no executable scripts, package installs, or automatic setup behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: WebSearch/WebFetch and optional Brave API search are proportionate to current card-benefit research, but card names and wallet composition may be sent to external search/fetch providers.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no persistence, background workers, local profile access, account-login access, account mutation authority, or elevated privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this if you are comfortable sharing the names of cards in your wallet with web search/fetch services during an audit. Do not provide full card numbers, CVV, SSN, account logins, account balances, or transaction histories.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector-current-clean] expected: The supplied current SkillSpector report found no issues and matches the artifact review: only a markdown instruction file is present.
[VirusTotal-pending] expected: VirusTotal telemetry is pending and provides no negative artifact-backed signal.
[Static-artifact-review] expected: The optional curl example is limited to Brave Search API calls, not arbitrary fetched URLs, and the skill includes URL safety rules for WebFetch use.
[Metadata-privacy-scope-note] expected: Older metadata notes about broad activation and external lookup are real but purpose-aligned; they support user privacy guidance rather than a Review verdict.
